texts.orig: Abstract : We introduce the notion of p-adic spherical codes (in particular, p-adic kissing number problem). We show that the one-line proof for a variant of the Delsarte-Goethals-Seidel-KabatianskiiLevenshtein upper bound for spherical codes, obtained by Pfender [J. Combin. Theory Ser. A, 2007] , extends to p-adic Hilbert spaces.
